system.description:
Also at 5th level, you have learned to manifest a medical ninja’s signature support technique, the Mystical Palm.

As a Bonus Action, you can coat your hands in a highly condensed layer of medical chakra. For the duration of the next activity with a Medicine Kit, you gain the following benefits.

Sterile Channeling: When you use Light Patch Up this use does not count against the Light Patch Up use limit for creatures and the time required to use down to 10 minutes.

Surgical Insight: When using Heavy Patch Up, reduce the number of Charges you expend by 1 and the time requires to use down to a Short Rest.

Pulse Stabilization: When using any Adrenaline Injection, the creature wakes up with 1 Hit point, instead of remaining at 0.
